mutations.name: KB-17 trigger exception lets a nested update change more than the author
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.immutable_events_refuse_update() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$ begin if pg_trigger_depth() > 1 and old.created_by is not null and new.created_by is null then return new; end if; raise exception 'immutable_events rows cannot be changed' using errcode = '42501'; end; $$;

mutations.name: KB-17 UPDATE granted back to authenticated
mutations.sql: grant update on public.immutable_events to authenticated; create policy kb17_update_back on public.immutable_events for update to authenticated using (public.can_write_project(project_id));

mutations.name: KB-17 insert does not pin the author
mutations.sql: drop policy immutable_events_insert on public.immutable_events; create policy immutable_events_insert on public.immutable_events for insert to authenticated with check (public.can_write_project(project_id) and exists (select 1 from public.episodes e where e.id = immutable_events.established_in and e.project_id = immutable_events.project_id));

mutations.name: KB-17 insert on account membership instead of the project-write rule
mutations.sql: drop policy immutable_events_insert on public.immutable_events; create policy immutable_events_insert on public.immutable_events for insert to authenticated with check (created_by = (select auth.uid()) and exists (select 1 from public.projects p where p.id = immutable_events.project_id and public.has_account_access(p.account_id)) and exists (select 1 from public.episodes e where e.id = immutable_events.established_in and e.project_id = immutable_events.project_id));

mutations.name: KB-17 insert does not check the episode is in the project
mutations.sql: drop policy immutable_events_insert on public.immutable_events; create policy immutable_events_insert on public.immutable_events for insert to authenticated with check (created_by = (select auth.uid()) and public.can_write_project(project_id));

mutations.name: KB-17 delete on account membership instead of the project-write rule
mutations.sql: drop policy immutable_events_delete on public.immutable_events; create policy immutable_events_delete on public.immutable_events for delete to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.projects p where p.id = immutable_events.project_id and public.has_role_on_account(p.account_id)));

mutations.name: KB-17 add action throws the RLS refusal instead of returning it
KB-17 delete action reports success when nothing was deleted
